## Projects

- **[cliche.blog](https://cliche.blog/en)** — Self-hosted tech blog, in production since 2024. FastAPI · MySQL · Next.js on OCI, with ELK logging and an Nginx + Fail2ban security layer. ([source snapshot](https://github.com/Cirque-Du-Trash/main_blog_public))
- **[MusicLab](https://cliche.blog/en/posts/68)** — Music chart scraper and trend-analysis backend, built with Celery and Selenium.
- **[FastAPI_MySQL_Boilerplate](https://github.com/Cirque-Du-Trash/FastAPI_MySQL_Boilerplate)** — Starter template for FastAPI + MySQL projects.
- **[Youtube-to-wav](https://github.com/Cirque-Du-Trash/Youtube-to-wav)** — Small tool for pulling YouTube audio as WAV.

## Writing

- [**ELK was full of junk logs, so I cleaned it up**](https://cliche.blog/en/posts/94) — whitelist + `444` + Fail2ban: 1,696 requests blocked and 52 IPs banned in the first 24 hours.
